tagline.en: A closed ring round the New Territories, the longest trunk route in Hong Kong, assembled from roads opened between 1978 and 2007
tagline.zh: 环绕新界的闭合环线，全港最长的干线，由 1978 至 2007 年间陆续通车的道路拼合而成

start.en: None — Route 9 is a closed ring. The atlas draws it from Lam Tei in Tuen Mun; the route's own chainage starts at 0 at the Shing Mun Tunnels toll plaza in Tsuen Wan.
start.zh: 没有端点——9号干线是一条闭合环线。图集自屯门蓝地画起；路线本身的里程由荃湾城门隧道收费广场的 0 公里起算。

end.en: None — the drawn ring closes back at Lam Tei, after about 70.7 km around the New Territories.
end.zh: 没有端点——所绘环线环绕新界约 70.7 公里后，回到蓝地闭合。

en: Route 9 is a ring. It leaves the Shing Mun Tunnels toll plaza in Tsuen Wan, goes through the tunnels to Sha Tin, and runs anticlockwise round the New Territories — Tai Po, Fanling, Sheung Shui, the border at San Tin, Yuen Long, Tuen Mun and back along the coast to Tsuen Wan — until it returns to the same toll plaza. Its chainage runs from 0 to about 70.7 km, which makes it the longest trunk route in Hong Kong, and it links every new town in the New Territories except those of Sai Kung and the Islands.

Since a ring has no east or west, its signs say A and B. Direction A runs clockwise, from the toll plaza towards Tsuen Wan and Tuen Mun with the chainage counting down; direction B runs anticlockwise, towards Sha Tin, with it counting up.

It is made of eleven roads: the Shing Mun Tunnels, Shing Mun Tunnel Road, Tai Po Road – Sha Tin, the Tolo Highway, the Fanling Highway, the San Tin Highway, a piece of the Tsing Long Highway, the Yuen Long Highway, Tuen Mun Road, a piece of Castle Peak Road – Tsuen Wan and Cheung Pei Shan Road. About 41 km of it, from the Yuen Long Highway in Tuen Mun round to Fo Tan, is unbroken expressway, the longest in Hong Kong. Routes 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 and 10 all begin or end on it, and between Kwu Tung and Lam Tei it carries Asian Highway 1, though that is not signed.

It replaced an older ring. Before it, Tai Po Road in the east and Castle Peak Road in the west met at their northern ends to circle the New Territories; the Fanling Highway took over part of the old Tai Po Road's line at Tai Wo and Fanling, and Tai Po Road now stops at Tai Po.
zh: 9号干线是一条环线。它由荃湾的城门隧道收费广场出发，穿过隧道到沙田，再逆时针环绕新界——大埔、粉岭、上水、新田边境、元朗、屯门，然后沿海岸返回荃湾——最后回到同一个收费广场。里程由 0 计至约 70.7 公里，是全港最长的干线，连接新界除西贡区和离岛区以外的所有新市镇。
环线没有东西南北之分，路牌上以 A、B 表示方向：A 方向为顺时针，由收费广场往荃湾、屯门，里程递减；B 方向为逆时针，往沙田，里程递增。
它由十一段道路组成：城门隧道、城门隧道公路、大埔公路－沙田段、吐露港公路、粉岭公路、新田公路、一段青朗公路、元朗公路、屯门公路、一段青山公路－荃湾段及象鼻山路。由屯门的元朗公路至火炭约 41 公里为连续不断的快速公路，是全港最长。1、2、3、5、8 及 10号干线都在此起讫；古洞至蓝地一段同时是亚洲公路 1 号线，但香港并无标示。
它取代了一条更早的环路。在它之前，东面的大埔公路与西面的青山公路在北端相接，环绕新界；粉岭公路占用了旧大埔公路大窝段和粉岭段的路线，如今大埔公路只到大埔为止。

en: Tuen Mun Road was Hong Kong's first expressway, and a hard one to build: there was little flat land along the winding coast, so it needed deep cuttings, high embankments, culverts and three long bridges, at Sham Tseng, Tsing Lung Tau and the old Ting Kau bridge. To save money it was built with narrow lanes and substandard curves and gradients — the first carriageway had no central reserve or hard shoulder — and it has been rebuilt more or less continuously since: crawler lanes from 1994, then a HK$4.6 billion reconstruction from 2008 to December 2015 that widened lanes, eased curves and added noise enclosures.

The Tolo Highway was built on a 7 km embankment along the west shore of Tolo Harbour beside the railway, then over the hills south of Tai Po, where four bridges over remote ravines were incrementally launched — the first use of the method in Hong Kong. It was widened to four lanes each way between Ma Liu Shui and Island House in 1999–2003 and from Island House to Tai Hang in 2009–2014; its viaduct at Tai Po is one of three eight-lane viaducts in Hong Kong.

The Shing Mun Tunnels are two pairs of twin-tube tunnels, 1 km through Smuggler's Ridge and 1.6 km through Needle Hill, joined by viaducts over the valley of Lower Shing Mun Reservoir, with ventilation shafts on each side of the valley. The toll plaza is at the Tsuen Wan end, which makes it the only Sha Tin tunnel whose tolls are taken outside Sha Tin.
zh: 屯门公路是香港第一条快速公路，也是早年最难修建的道路：曲折的海岸线旁平地极少，需要大量削坡、筑路堤和暗渠，并建有深井桥、青龙头桥和旧汀九桥三条较长的行车桥。为节省成本，它建成时车道狭窄、弯位和坡度都不达标——第一期车道既无分隔岛也无路肩——此后几乎不断改建：1994 年起加设爬坡车道，2008 年至 2015 年 12 月再以 46 亿港元全面重建，扩阔车道、改善弯位并加建隔音罩。
吐露港公路沿吐露港西岸、在铁路旁筑约 7 公里海堤而成，再越过大埔以南的山坡；途中横跨偏远深谷的四座桥梁以「分段曳进法」兴建，是香港首次采用这种方法。马料水至元洲仔一段于 1999 至 2003 年扩为四线双程，元洲仔至泰亨一段于 2009 至 2014 年扩阔；其大埔段高架路是全港三条八线高架路之一。
城门隧道由两组双管隧道组成——穿过孖指径的 1 公里和穿过针山的 1.6 公里——中间以高架桥跨越下城门水塘所在的山谷，山谷两侧各设通风竖井。收费广场设在荃湾一端，是所有贯通沙田的隧道中唯一不设于沙田区的收费广场。

en: Tuen Mun was made a new town in 1973 with little more than Castle Peak Road and a ferry to connect it. On 10 June 1974 the government approved Tuen Mun Road at a little over HK$220 million (later about HK$500 million with the additions), work began that October, and the Governor, Murray MacLehose, opened the first carriageway — today's Tsuen Wan-bound side, then three lanes for both directions — on 5 May 1978. The second carriageway was finished on 17 May 1983.

The eastern side came next. The Tolo Highway, built as the Tai Po–Sha Tin coastal road and opened unnamed as the 'New Territories trunk road, Sha Tin to Fanling section', opened with the Fanling Highway from Wo Hop Shek to Lam Kam Road on 25 September 1985. The Fanling Highway reached Pak Shek Au in 1987 and San Tin in August 1991, the San Tin Highway reached Au Tau in January 1993, and the Yuen Long Highway was completed in stages in 1993 and 1994.

The Shing Mun Tunnels closed the Tsuen Wan–Sha Tin side on 20 April 1990, after the Governor, David Wilson, opened them the day before. They were built as part of the old Route 5; the ring was given its single number, 9, in the renumbering of January 2004, pieced together from the old Routes 1, 2 and 5.

The last gap was in Tsuen Wan. Cheung Pei Shan Road, from Chai Wan Kok to Shek Wai Kok and through the Discovery Park development, opened on 8 February 2007 and completed the ring — the only piece of Route 9 built after the number was given.
zh: 屯门于 1973 年发展为新市镇，对外交通几乎只有青山公路和渡轮。1974 年 6 月 10 日，政府批准以 2 亿 2 千多万港元（其后因扩建增至约 5 亿港元）兴建屯门公路，同年 10 月动工。1978 年 5 月 5 日，港督麦理浩主持第一期通车——即今日往荃湾方向的车道，当时来回共用三条车道。第二期车道于 1983 年 5 月 17 日全线通车。
其后到东面。吐露港公路的工程名称为「大埔至沙田沿海公路」，通车时尚未命名，只称「新界干线公路沙田至粉岭段」，于 1985 年 9 月 25 日连同粉岭公路和合石至林锦公路一段通车。粉岭公路于 1987 年通至白石凹，1991 年 8 月通至新田；新田公路于 1993 年 1 月通至凹头；元朗公路则于 1993 及 1994 年分段完成。
城门隧道于 1990 年 4 月 20 日通车，港督卫奕信于前一日主持启用，接通了荃湾至沙田一侧。它当时属旧5号干线；2004 年 1 月重新编号时，整个环线才以旧 1、2、5号干线的路段拼合，统一编为9号干线。
最后的缺口在荃湾。由柴湾角经愉景新城至石围角的象鼻山路于 2007 年 2 月 8 日通车，环线完满建成——这是9号干线中唯一在定名之后才兴建的路段。

en: Route 9 is a government road. Every part of it was built from the public works programme and is free except the Shing Mun Tunnels, which are government-owned, run by a management contractor and charge HK$8 since September 2025 (franchised buses free). The tolled, privately built alternative in the west, the Tai Lam Tunnel, is on Route 3, not Route 9; its rising tolls have long pushed traffic back onto the free Tuen Mun Road.
zh: 9号干线是政府道路，各段均由工务计划拨款兴建；除城门隧道外全线免费。城门隧道由政府拥有、管理承办商营运，自 2025 年 9 月起收费 8 元（专营巴士免费）。西面另一条私人兴建、收费的通道大榄隧道属于3号干线，并非9号干线；其不断加价，长期令车流回流到免费的屯门公路。

en: The ring's character changes with the road. The Tolo Highway is a 100 km/h motorway, mostly four lanes each way; Tuen Mun Road is limited to 70 km/h through Tuen Mun town centre and from Sham Tseng to Tsuen Wan, 80 km/h between, because of its curves; through Tuen Mun town centre it is not a designated expressway. The Shing Mun Tunnels are 70 km/h.

Tuen Mun Road has had some of Hong Kong's worst accidents. On 10 July 2003 a lorry hit a double-decker bus near the Ting Kau interchange and knocked it off the viaduct into Ting Kau village 35 m below; 21 people died, then the worst road accident in Hong Kong's history. In 1995 a rockfall on the Tai Lam section killed a driver, and closing the road to make it safe cut off the north-west New Territories for days.
zh: 环线的性质随路段而变。吐露港公路为限速每小时 100 公里的快速公路，大部分为四线双程；屯门公路因弯多，屯门市中心及深井至荃湾一段限速 70 公里，其间为 80 公里，而屯门市中心一段并非法定快速公路。城门隧道限速 70 公里。
屯门公路曾发生香港数一数二严重的意外。2003 年 7 月 10 日，一辆货车在汀九交汇处附近撞向一辆双层巴士，巴士冲出高架桥，堕入 35 米下的汀九村，造成 21 人死亡，是当时香港史上最严重的交通意外。1995 年，大榄段发生塌石，击毙一名司机；当局为安全封闭道路，令新界西北对外交通瘫痪多日。

why.en: No cost has been published for the ring as a whole: its eleven roads were built as separate projects between 1974 and 2007. Sourced figures for the larger pieces are below.
why.zh: 环线整体没有公布造价：其十一段道路是在 1974 至 2007 年间分别兴建的。较大路段有来源的数字列于下方。

value.en: Approved in 1974 at a little over HK$220 million; about HK$500 million after enlargement
value.zh: 1974 年批准 2 亿 2 千多万港元；扩建后增至约 5 亿港元

figures.source: Wah Kiu Yat Po, 20 April 1990, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 城门隧道

label.en: Tolo Highway widening, Ma Liu Shui – Island House
label.zh: 吐露港公路扩阔（马料水至元洲仔）

value.en: HK$2,507.2 million requested from the Legislative Council in October 1998
value.zh: 1998 年 10 月向立法会申请拨款 25.072 亿港元

figures.source: PWSC(98-99)26, Provisional Legislative Council Public Works Subcommittee, 7 October 1998, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 吐露港公路

value.en: The Hong Kong government, through the public works programme. No section is a franchise; the Shing Mun Tunnels are government-built and government-owned.
value.zh: 香港政府，经工务计划拨款。没有任何路段采用专营权模式；城门隧道由政府投资兴建并拥有。

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 城门隧道 (兴建模式：政府投资兴建), 屯门公路, 吐露港公路

value.en: About 70.7 km by chainage round the ring (English Wikipedia gives 70.8 km)
value.zh: 按环线里程约 70.7 公里（英文维基百科作 70.8 公里）

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 9號幹線; English Wikipedia, Route 9 (Hong Kong)

timeline.en: Tuen Mun Road is approved on 10 June; work begins on 1 October.
timeline.zh: 6 月 10 日屯门公路获批，10 月 1 日动工。

timeline.en: Governor MacLehose opens the first carriageway of Tuen Mun Road, Hong Kong's first expressway, on 5 May.
timeline.zh: 5 月 5 日，港督麦理浩主持屯门公路第一期通车，这是香港第一条快速公路。

timeline.en: Tuen Mun Road's second carriageway is completed on 17 May.
timeline.zh: 5 月 17 日，屯门公路第二期车道全线通车。

timeline.en: The Tolo Highway and the Fanling Highway from Wo Hop Shek to Lam Kam Road open on 25 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 25 日，吐露港公路及粉岭公路和合石至林锦公路段通车。

timeline.en: The Shing Mun Tunnels open on 20 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 20 日，城门隧道通车。

timeline.en: The Fanling Highway reaches San Tin in August.
The San Tin Highway reaches Au Tau in January; the Yuen Long Highway opens to the Tuen Mun eastern corridor in July.
timeline.zh: 1 月新田公路通至凹头；7 月元朗公路通至屯门东走廊。

timeline.en: A bus falls from Tuen Mun Road at Ting Kau on 10 July, killing 21; the Tolo Highway widening to Island House is finished in August.
timeline.zh: 7 月 10 日，一辆巴士在汀九堕下屯门公路，21 人死亡；8 月，吐露港公路至元洲仔扩阔工程完成。

timeline.en: The ring is numbered Route 9 in the January renumbering.
timeline.zh: 1 月重新编号，环线统一编为9号干线。

timeline.en: Cheung Pei Shan Road opens from Chai Wan Kok to Shek Wai Kok on 8 February, completing the ring.
timeline.zh: 2 月 8 日，象鼻山路柴湾角至石围角段通车，环线完满建成。

timeline.en: The reconstruction of Tuen Mun Road is completed in December.
timeline.zh: 12 月，屯门公路重建及改善工程完成。
